title: Making a dialog usable by keyboard

concepts.description: A dialog moves keyboard focus into itself when it opens and returns it to the control that opened it when it closes.
concepts.context: saves the opener and restores focus in the effect cleanup

concepts.description: role=dialog with aria-modal and a label tells assistive technology what the region is and that the page behind is inert.
concepts.context: adds role, aria-modal and aria-labelledby to the Modal root
